Subject: Your ohmail account data is erased in a week

ohmail.

We erase your account data in a week.

On 16 October 2026, 00:00 UTC, we erase your ohmail account data: your rules, your Screener decisions and your settings. ohmail touches nothing in your mailbox. Your mail was never ours to hold.

Sign in before then to keep the account, or export your settings first.

Open your ohmail account:
https://app.ohmail.app/#/settings/account

--
Write to support@ohmail.app and a person answers.
